description: Sealed webhook protocol v2 (proposed). Verify the envelope with the pinned sender pair and the receiver identity at `now`, verify the acknowledgement with the pinned acknowledgement pair, recompute the signed bytes from the parsed members, and require every negative body to be refused with its class. Keys marked test-only exist for these vectors only.

negative.name: valid signatures but another receiver's recipient id
hybrid ciphertext with an extra stanza
non-canonical ciphertext base64 tail (stray trailing bits)
non-canonical ed25519 signature tail (stray trailing bits)
upper-case duplicate of a signature member
line break inside the ciphertext base64
ack with the ml-dsa signature stripped
ack with a forged ed25519 signature
